commands:
set -eu
chown fyp:fyp /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification/bootstrap-lf.sh
chmod 600 /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification/bootstrap-lf.sh
runuser -u fyp -- bash -c 'cd /opt/fyp-phase8-linux-v1; bash /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification/bootstrap-lf.sh' > /srv/fyp-p82/bootstrap-attempt2.log 2>&1
cat >/etc/systemd/system/fyp-p82-qualification.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Finite Phase 8.2 calibration only, main study disabled
After=docker.service network-online.target
[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=fyp
Group=fyp
SupplementaryGroups=docker
WorkingDirectory=/opt/fyp-phase8-linux-v1
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
Environment=P8_DOCKER_DATA_PATH=/srv/fyp-p82
ExecStart=/opt/fyp-phase8-linux-v1/.venv/bin/python /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification/qualify.py /srv/fyp-p82/native-original /srv/fyp-p82-backup/native-original
KillMode=process
TimeoutStartSec=40min
Restart=no
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
UNIT
# Explicit alternative probe path is permitted only on the same filesystem.
test "$(stat -c %d /var/lib/docker)" = "$(stat -c %d /srv/fyp-p82)"
systemctl daemon-reload
printf '%s\n' READY_FOR_QUALIFICATION_MAIN_BLOCKED >/srv/fyp-p82/bootstrap-ready-attempt2.txt
runuser -u fyp -- bash -c 'cd /opt/fyp-phase8-linux-v1; PYTHONPATH=/opt/fyp-phase8-linux-v1/.venv-analysis/lib/python3.12/site-packages:/opt/fyp-phase8-linux-v1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest artifacts/phase-8-linux-setup/v1/test_linux.py tests/test_execution_setup.py artifacts/phase-8-execution-setup/v2/test_storage.py tests/unit/test_phase8_candidate_v4.py -q' > /srv/fyp-p82/linux-regression-attempt2.txt 2>&1
cat /srv/fyp-p82/linux-regression-attempt2.txt
